entities.summary: Kuwait City is the capital and largest city of Kuwait. Located at the heart of the country on the south shore of Kuwait Bay on the Persian Gulf, it is the political, cultural and economic primate city of the emirate, being home to all headquarters of most Kuwaiti corporations and entirety of its banking system.
